address: 197 Richmond Road, London Fields, London, E8 3NJ, United Kingdom
bio: Pophams is an artisan bakery during the day but, on four evenings a week, it morphs into an appealingly simple Italian restaurant. Dishes are bright and carefully prepared, with the pasta dishes the stars of the show. A stool at the stone counter looking into the open kitchen is the place to sit, although the pavement terrace is perfect on summer days....
